title: Motown Party Event Poster
coreRelationships: The collage of artist portraits forms a prominent 'M' shape, acting as the primary visual anchor.
The distressed green background provides a vintage, aged aesthetic that unifies all elements.
The cream/off-white text stands out against the dark green, ensuring readability and a retro feel.
The bold, blocky 'MOTOWN' text contrasts with the flowing 'Party' script, creating visual interest and hierarchy.
The dark, grunge border frames the entire composition, enhancing the vintage poster effect.
reuseFormula: Create a distressed, desaturated green background with a dark, grunge border. Form a large 'M' shape in the upper-middle section using a high-contrast, black-and-white collage of generic or new artist portraits. Below this, place the main title 'MOTOWN' in a bold, blocky cream sans-serif font, followed by 'Party' in a flowing cream script font. Add event details (date, DJ name) in cream sans-serif fonts at the top and bottom. Ensure all elements have a consistent vintage, textured appearance.
